test_title: PYST 25: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.

options.text: Rahul is very naughty as he is the most young sibling between Rama’s three brothers.
Rahul is very naughty as he is the youngest sibling among Rama’s three brothers.
Rahul is very naughty as he is the youngest sibling between Rama’s three brothers.
Rahul is very naughty as he is the most young sibling among Rama’s three brothers.

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Rahul is very naughty as he is the youngest sibling among Rama's three brothers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"youngest"** is the correct superlative form of "young"
